mil5.1.9:1.2: yaṃ kiñci karaṇīyaṃ Tathāgatassa sabban-taṃ bodhiyā yeva mūle pariniṭṭhitaṃ, na-tthi Tathāgatassa uttariṃ karaṇīyam katassa vā paticayo ti. Idañ-ca temāsaṃ paṭisallāṇaṃ dissati.
mil5.1.9:1.3: Yadi bhante Nāgasena yaṃ kiñci karaṇīyaṃ Tathāgatassa sabban-taṃ bodhiyā yeva mūle pariniṭṭhitaṃ, na-tthi Tathāgatassa uttariṃ karaṇīyam katassa vā paticayo; tena hi: temāsaṃ paṭisallīno ti yaṃ vacanaṃ taṃ micchā.
mil5.1.9:1.4: Yadi temāsaṃ paṭisallīno, tena hi: yaṃ kiñci karaṇīyaṃ Tathāgatassa sabban-taṃ bodhiyā yeva mūle pariniṭṭhitan-ti tam-pi vacanaṃ micchā.
mil5.1.9:1.5: Na-tthi katakaraṇīyassa paṭisallāṇaṃ, sakaraṇīyass' eva paṭisallāṇaṃ. Yathā nāma āitass' eva bhesajjena karaṇīyaṃ hoti, abyādhitassa kiṃ bhesajjena,
mil5.1.9:1.6: chātass' eva bhojanena karaṇīyaṃ hoti, achātassa kiṃ bhojanena;
mil5.1.9:1.7: evam-eva kho bhante Nāgasena na-tthi katakaraṇīyassa paṭisallāṇaṃ, sakaraṇīyass' eva paṭisallāṇaṃ.
mil5.1.9:1.8: Ayam-pi ubhatokoṭiko pañho tavānuppatto, so tayā nibbāhitabbo ti.
mil5.1.9:2.1: Yaṃ kiñci mahārāja karaṇīyaṃ Tathāgatassa sabbantaṃ bodhiyā yeva mūle pariniṭṭhitaṃ, na-tthi Tathāgatassa uttariṃ karaṇīyaṃ katassa vā paticayo. Bhagavā ca temāsaṃ paṭisallīno. Paṭisallāṇaṃ kho mahārāja bahuguṇaṃ, sabbe pi tathāgatā paṭisallīyitvā sabbaññutaṃ pattā, taṃ te sukataguṇam-anussarantā paṭisallāṇaṃ sevanti.
mil5.1.9:2.2: Yathā mahārāja puriso rañño santikā laddhavaro paṭiladdhasabhogo taṃ sukataguṇam-anussaranto aparāparaṃ rañño upaṭṭhānaṃ eti,
mil5.1.9:2.3: evam-eva kho mahārāja sabbe pi tathāgatā paṭisallīyitvā sabbaññutaṃ pattā, taṃ te sukataguṇam-anussarantā paṭisallāṇaṃ sevanti.
mil5.1.9:3.1: Yathā vā pana mahārāja puriso āturo dukkhito bāḷhagilāno bhisakkam-upasevitvā sotthim-anuppatto taṃ sukataguṇamanussaranto aparāparaṃ bhisakkam-upasevati,
mil5.1.9:3.2: evam-eva kho mahārāja sabbe pi tathāgatā paṭisallīyitvā sabbaññutaṃ pattā, taṃ te sukataguṇam-anussarantā paṭisallāṇaṃ sevanti.
mil5.1.9:4.1: Aṭṭhavīsati kho pan' ime mahārāja paṭisallāṇaguṇā ye guṇe samanupassantā tathāgatā paṭisallāṇaṃ sevanti,
mil5.1.9:4.3: idha mahārāja paṭisallāṇaṃ paṭisallīyamānaṃ rakkhati, āyuṃ vaḍḍheti, balaṃ deti, vajjaṃ pidahati, ayasam-apaneti, yasam-upaneti, aratiṃ vinodeti, ratim-upadahati, bhayam-apaneti, vesārajjaṃ karoti, kosajjam-apaneti, viriyam-abhijaneti, rāgam-apaneti, dosam-apaneti, moham-apaneti, mānaṃ nihanti, vitakkaṃ bhañjati, cittaṃ ekaggaṃ karoti, mānasaṃ snehayati, hāsaṃ janeti, garukaṃ karoti, lābham-uppādayati, namassiyaṃ karoti, pītiṃ pāpeti, pāmojjaṃ karoti, sankhārānaṃ sabhāvaṃ dassayati, bhavapaṭisandhiṃ ugghāṭeti, sabbasāmaññaṃ deti.
mil5.1.9:4.4: Ime kho mahārāja aṭṭhavīsati paṭisallāṇaguṇā ye guṇe samanupassantā tathāgatā paṭisallāṇaṃ sevanti.
mil5.1.9:5.1: Api ca kho mahārāja tathāgatā santaṃ sukhaṃ samāpattiratim-anubhavitukāmā paṭisallāṇaṃ sevanti pariyositasankappā.
mil5.1.9:5.2: Catuhi kho mahārāja kāraṇehi tathāgatā paṭisallāṇaṃ sevanti,
mil5.1.9:5.4: vihāraphāsutāya pi mahārāja tathāgatā paṭisallāṇaṃ sevanti, anavajjaguṇabahulatāya pi tathāgatā paṭisallāṇaṃ sevanti, asesāriyavīthito pi tathāgatā paṭisallāṇaṃ sevanti, sabbabuddhānaṃ thuta-thomita-vaṇṇita-pasatthato pi tathāgatā paṭisallāṇaṃ sevanti.
mil5.1.9:5.5: Imehi kho mahārāja catuhi kāraṇehi tathāgatā paṭisallāṇaṃ sevanti.
mil5.1.9:5.6: Iti kho mahārāja paṭisallāṇaṃ sevanti, na sakaraṇīyatāya, na katassa [vā] paticayāya, atha kho guṇavisesadassāvitāya tathāgatā paṭisallāṇaṃ sevantīti.-
mil5.1.9:5.7: Sādhu bhante Nāgasena, evam-etaṃ, tathā sampaṭicchāmīti.
